headlines.title: Longtime Fox News host Maria Bartiromo disputes reports of termination
headlines.summary: Maria Bartiromo, the longtime host of Fox News and Fox Business programming, has disputed reports she was fired from the cable TV networks.

headlines.title: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert to retire at the end of 2026
headlines.summary: Engelbert oversaw a period of unprecedented growth for the WNBA, but has faced criticism from players over her leadership.

headlines.title: THC drinks could soon be harder to find as Congress delays hemp ban again
headlines.summary: THC drinks are booming as an alcohol alternative, but a looming federal crackdown is squeezing makers, distributors and consumers.

headlines.title: Labor Day marks the start of fallcations as wealthy travelers avoid summer crowds
headlines.summary: Wealthy travelers are moving their typical summer getaways to autumn.

headlines.title: The wealth of the world s billionaires reached $15.1 trillion last year, per a new report
headlines.summary: The global billionaire count hit a record of 3,795 people last year, with the biggest wealth gains for the richest of the rich, per a recent Altrata report.

headlines.title: Automakers urge Congress to permanently ban Chinese connected vehicles in U.S.
headlines.summary: Major automakers in the U.S. are urging Congress to ban the domestic sale, import and manufacturing of Chinese connected vehicles, hardware and software.

headlines.title: ChargePoint CEO says 70% stock surge is the beginning of the momentum
headlines.summary: The infrastructure company is toward the end of a three-year business plan that has boosted revenue and significantly cut the company's losses.

headlines.title: NFL set for first-ever game in Melbourne, Australia, in international expansion
headlines.summary: The San Francisco 49ers and the L.A. Rams are playing the NFL's first-ever game in Australia, marking an expanded push to grow the game internationally.

headlines.title: Billionaire family offices back healthcare and biotech startups in August
headlines.summary: The personal investment firms of titans like Stanley Druckenmiller are backing innovations in gene editing, drug discovery and more.

headlines.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
headlines.summary: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

headlines.title: Southwest to debut airport lounges in four cities, with more to come
headlines.summary: The airline is partnering with Chase on the effort, saying it wants to build on that company's Sapphire Reserve Lounge Network.

headlines.title: Ford s production of highly profitable Super Duty trucks hits 20-year high as it recovers from supplier fires
headlines.summary: Ford reported its eighth consecutive month of year-over-year U.S. new vehicle sales declines in August.

headlines.title: American Airlines continues premium push with redesigned Boeing planes
headlines.summary: American Airlines is adding its most premium seats to its largest planes, which it uses for its most popular long international flights.

headlines.title: Stan Kroenke agrees to buy MLB s Angels, valuing team and regional network at $4 billion
headlines.summary: Kroenke Sports and Entertainment was valued at more than $26 billion in CNBC's most recent list of the world's most valuable sports empires.

headlines.title: Toyota s hybrid RAV4 is in demand as dealers wait for more supply
headlines.summary: When Toyota announced the new version of its SUV, it said the RAV4 would only be available as a hybrid and that production would be limited at first.

headlines.title: Livestream shopping is gaining steam in the U.S., thanks to apps like TikTok and Whatnot
headlines.summary: Whatnot and TikTok are tapping into its potential livestream shopping in the U.S. after a decade of massive success in China.

headlines.title: How one of the largest investors in student housing is playing this school year
headlines.summary: Mike Gordon of Harrison Street Asset Management said funding cuts and enrollment trends are making specialization more vital than ever.

headlines.title: OneRail launches AI platform with Nvidia for retailers to make faster delivery decisions
headlines.summary: Last-mile delivery company OneRail is launching a new platform with Nvidia to use AI to help retailers make faster and more efficient delivery decisions.

headlines.title: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
headlines.summary: The expectation had been for falling rates this year, but the war with Iran and its resulting rise in oil prices upended that.

headlines.title: Trump strikes new drug pricing deals with nine midsized drugmakers
headlines.summary: The string of deals builds on the Trump administration's push to link the nation's drug prices to cheaper ones abroad.

trend_headline: 지정학적 리스크와 유가 상승이 자극하는 모기지 금리 급등
summary: 중동발 충돌과 이란과의 긴장 고조로 유가가 급등하면서 인플레이션 우려가 재부각되었고, 이는 모기지 금리를 6월 이후 최고치로 끌어올렸습니다. 거시경제적 불확실성 속에서도 기업들은 AI 인프라 투자와 공급망 재편에 집중하는 모습을 보였습니다.
key_points: 중동발 새로운 공격과 유가 상승 여파로 모기지 금리가 2025년 6월 이후 최고치로 급등
포드, 공급망 차질 속에서도 고수익 차종인 수퍼 듀티 트럭 생산량을 20년 만에 최고치로 기록
마이크론, AI 수요 급증에 대응하기 위해 고수익 AI 메모리 칩 생산 능력 확대 추진
